description:
Incorporated in 1996, Genus Paper & Boards Ltd manufactures Kraft paper and invests in shares, securities and loans [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] [3] GPBL is a division of Kailash Group of Companies. It is a paper manufacturer of various grades of kraft paper and duplex paper (waste paper-based) in the range of 230 GSM to 450 GSM respectively. Apart from this, company is also engaged in strategic investments in shares and securities.
